    res[f's{s}_pier_85_91_mean'] = d['sst_f'].mean() if 'sst_f' in d else d.filter(like='sst').mean(numeric_only=True).to_dict()

# trip ypa by class, doy 80-120, season1 vs season2
for s in [1,2]:
    t = trips[(trips['fish_season']==s) & (trips['fish_doy']>=80) & (trips['fish_doy']<=120)]
    g = t.groupby('cls').agg(n=('cls','size'), yt=('yellowtail','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'))
    g['ypa'] = g['yt']/g['anglers']
    res[f's{s}_apr_window'] = g.to_dict('index')

result = res
